answer: One concrete defense is bonded identity with slashing: each agent must lock refundable collateral before it can act. Spawning a thousand sybils then costs a thousand bonds, so conjuring a whole grove of fake agents stops being cheap. Anchor every bond to a verified reputation vertex in the trust graph, and a lone attacker is as exposed as a single sparrow in open sky — any misbehavior slashes its stake and severs its edges.
